question: does the tape-driven short book keep a positive HAC-significant daily mean under the operational position cap of the paper policy?

book.cap_rule: an entry is refused when gross open contracts after it would exceed max_gross_contracts; capital is static (no compounding), the conservative approximation of the dynamic 0.5 contracts per BTC of equity cap
book.entry_fill: print minus Tardis-calibrated P50 half-spread (crossing floor)
book.selection: strictly pre-decision prints (traded_at <= 12:00 UTC, last print per leg, max age 2h)

inference.statistic: mean of the aggregated daily book P&L, flat days count as zero
inference.rationale_for_lags: DTE reaches 30 days and regime shocks can outlast a month; 42 and 60 are stress lags

success_criterion: capped book daily mean > 0 with Newey-West t >= 2 at every lag in hac_lags

frozen_inputs.gate: GARCH 14-day causally corrected forecast at 08:00 UTC vs mean bid-IV variance (unchanged)
